stem: Which sentence from the selection helps explain why the Sweethearts became successful?

options.label: A
options.text: Swing musicians usually played instruments such as the clarinet, the saxophone, the trombone, and the trumpet.

options.label: B
options.text: At this point a few new musicians joined the group.

options.label: C
options.text: The women chose to include “International” in the band’s name because they came from many different cultural backgrounds.

options.label: D
options.text: But they remained focused on their main ambition: to play great swing music.
